scope: Implementation-ready architecture and task slices only. This revision integrates final DEC-7/D7-C and DEC-3/D3-A into the prior one-engine, D1 safety, D2 planner/lease, bundle, host, recovery, sandbox, artifact-size, and beacon contracts. It changes no source, tests, configuration, documentation, canonical state, or workflow control state.

architecture_status.decision_state: all ten decisions final; zero open decisions or gates
architecture_status.integrated_guarantee: One core engine owns safety, resolution, planning, state, recovery, and checkpoint semantics. EffectiveConfigResolver is the sole provenance authority; its redacted state is resume/planning authority, its retained report is a deterministic projection, and logs are telemetry only. D3-A rejects legacy tiers before planning and binds a core-owned situational rubric plus non-overriding namespaced bundle dimensions into selection, plan, and resume identity.
non_negotiables: PHASE-0 model-first autonomy; keywords, commands, aliases, legacy tiers, manifests, discovery, and credentials never grant autonomy or remove a floor.
D1-C exact five-class ordinary floor; profile gates are additive; scoped SandboxGrant is never a blanket bypass.

D2-C typed closed/disjoint plan has one candidate per ready independent slice, central run-wide leases (8 global, 3 per role, one manual-QA owner, one fan-in owner), deterministic non-dropping waves, ordered fallback, and immutable hash-bound launch.
D3-A has no alias, preset, mapping, ranking, or deprecation path for legacy tiers; typed nested/persisted values fail before planning.
D7-C has one current snapshot and latest 32 monotonic invalidation/fallback events; snapshot, ring, and report projection publish atomically with CAS; event 33 evicts exactly the oldest entry.
Only normalized repo-relative paths, stable IDs, and hashes cross a durability boundary; logs cannot repair or authorize state.

preserved_architecture.core_boundary: packages/core remains the single engine, resolver, checkpoint/safety path, planner, lease coordinator, lifecycle/recovery, fan-in, artifact validation, and durable-state authority. No second bundle engine, planner, sandbox policy, or permission system is introduced.
preserved_architecture.bundle_boundary: packages/fullstack contributes descriptive versioned BundleManifestV1, namespaced role/capability/fallback catalogs, OMP capabilities, claims, and host-verified hyphen aliases. Metadata never grants permission or remaps model roles.
selection_and_ownership: Canonical ownership uses documented native > built-in > core precedence; every challenger is diagnosed and ambiguous canonical ownership fails closed.
Selection precedence is explicit namespace/argument > project .omp config > exactly one enabled compatible bundle; zero, multiple, or incompatible candidates fail closed with provenance.

Only host-verified /do-work-<bundle>, /team-<bundle>, /cto-<bundle> aliases are claimed, including omp; colon grammar is not an API. Copied project commands remain compatibility artifacts, never an override API.
preserved_architecture.d1_sandbox: Ordinary modes human-gate exactly production deploy/rollback; destructive or irreversible git/filesystem/database/data/schema effects; irreversible external publish/send/payment/account effects; credential/access/security-policy changes; and cancellation/restart of a live worker whose computation may be lost. A complete scoped SandboxGrant permits zero runtime checkpoints only for proven approved dev/validation actions; forbidden, ambiguous, expired, revoked, or mismatched actions become durable redacted deferrals while reachable work continues.
preserved_architecture.d2_planner: The versioned WorkDecompositionPlan uses typed disjoint/closed graph validation, evidence-only file counts, no token/time/effort multiplier, capability-derived multiplicity, ordered compatible fallback, overrides-last atomic validation, mandatory-risk/critical-path/phase/slice-id waves, and plan identity. D3 rubric hashes are additive identity components; the six D2 identity components remain present.
preserved_architecture.d2_leases: One GlobalLeaseCoordinator is shared by parent and nested teams through an opaque handle. Acquire/release are generation CAS operations; heartbeat, TTL, silence, missing beacon, or temporary artifact absence never reclaim an ambiguous lease. Duplicate or foreign release never decrements counters.
preserved_architecture.d6_d9_host_recovery: Regular steering uses the host safe queue/tool-call boundary; urgent abort is distinct. Accepted|started|not_started|completed is authoritative; one replay is allowed only with trustworthy not_started proof, otherwise manual resolution. Recovery restores same-stage computed work before rerun and never polls or silently drops work.
preserved_architecture.af_contracts: AF-1 measures UTF-8 artifact size before parse/persist, never truncates, and allows one same-worker compaction. AF-2 beacons are self-emitted at safe boundaries; absence is evidence only and never interrupts an active call.
compatibility: Profiles without dynamic-slice declarations retain their prior artifact chains.
Unsupported plan, grant, state, report, rubric, manifest, or mapping schema fails closed rather than approximating.
D3-A is intentionally breaking only for the legacy tier vocabulary; no compatibility alias or deprecation window is added. All other prior contracts remain additive and versioned.

authority.resolver: EffectiveConfigResolver is the only reader/normalizer/provenance authority used by engine and command entrypoints.
authority.state: EffectiveConfigProvenanceState is the only planning and resume authority for the run.
authority.report: EffectiveConfigReport is a deterministic human-readable projection of accepted state, retained with run artifacts; finalized projection is immutable.
authority.logs: Event/log output is telemetry only. Missing, truncated, reordered, or altered logs never alter planning, invalidation, state, report, or resume.

resolver_contract.name: EffectiveConfigResolver
ordered_steps: Resolve project root and CWD once; construct a typed source chain with precedence and source hashes.
Parse only versioned typed config/input/state/output schemas; measure raw artifacts before parsing under AF-1.
Run LegacyTierScanner on typed surfaces before option ranking, rubric evaluation, shape discovery, or planning.
Resolve explicit namespace/argument > .omp config > exactly one compatible enabled bundle; validate claims and BundleManifestV1.
Validate core rubric and accepted namespaced bundle dimensions; compute rubric and dimension schema identities.
Capture effective config, manifest, catalog, discovered inventory, selection, mapping generation/CAS, ordered fallback outcomes, and invalidation identity without values.
Normalize/redact all references, canonicalize fields, hash the accepted result, and atomically publish state, ring event, and report projection.
Emit only redacted telemetry after the authoritative publication; return the accepted result or a typed fail-closed error.
resolver_contract.single_result_rule: Engine and command entrypoints receive the same accepted ResolverResult object; no caller rereads config, mapping, manifest, rubric, or report independently.

fields: path_ref:normalized repo-relative path or opaque ID/hash
EffectiveConfigSource.value_policy: No source values; source_id/path_ref/source_hash are sufficient for provenance without content.

EffectiveConfig.value_policy_detail: No effective values, raw arguments, prompts, tokens, credentials, or secret presence beyond boolean/hash markers are persisted.

GenerationCAS.rule: All generation values are monotonic per authority; a stale writer cannot overwrite a newer snapshot or ring.

EffectiveConfigSnapshot.rule: Exactly one current snapshot exists per run; snapshot_hash is over canonical redacted fields and excludes timestamps, raw values, and telemetry.

EffectiveConfigEvent.rule: The durable ring contains only invalidation/fallback events, in seq order, with at most 32 entries; event 33 evicts the minimum seq atomically.

invariants: next_event_seq is one greater than the highest committed seq
state_hash covers only canonical redacted state
state is valid without log or report
EffectiveConfigProvenanceState.retention: The finalized report artifact is independently retained/addressable by run_artifact_id even if state cleanup or telemetry cleanup occurs.

EffectiveConfigReport.projection_rule: Canonical section order, field order, sorted identifiers, UTF-8, and newline rules make both structured projection and human-readable rendering byte-stable. It contains hashes/IDs, not effective values.
EffectiveConfigReport.finalization: Finalization records projection_hash and retains the report with run artifacts. A later accepted state publishes a new state generation and new report version; it never mutates a finalized report.

RedactionReceipt.rule: Receipt contains no rejected raw values or reversible material.

identity_formula.hash: sha256(canonical_json(canonical_input)); sorted keys/sets, UTF-8, no timestamps, secrets, raw values, or logs
identity_formula.resume_rule: Recompute identity from current typed inputs and compare every named component before planning; any drift is stale and requires re-resolution/new plan.

atomic_publication.unit: one CAS transaction publishes current_snapshot, ring append/oldest eviction, state_generation/state_hash, report projection/reference, and report_projection_hash, or publishes none
algorithm: construct redacted candidate and event seq
if ring length=32 drop only minimum seq in candidate
write state and report through atomic rename/transaction with commit_id
atomic_publication.conflict: A loser rereads authoritative state and retries only if the resolver input/identity is still valid; otherwise returns EFFECTIVE_CONFIG_STATE_CAS_CONFLICT or EFFECTIVE_CONFIG_IDENTITY_DRIFT. No partial snapshot, ring, or report is visible.
atomic_publication.overflow_example: With events 1..32, append seq 33 commits ring 2..33 exactly; snapshot remains current and unchanged except for the new generation/report projection.

resume_and_recovery.valid_state: Validate state schema, canonical state_hash, single snapshot, ring order/capacity, report reference/hash relation, generations, selection/mapping/rubric identities, and current plan identity. Valid state resumes even when logs and report are absent.
resume_and_recovery.missing_report: Valid state regenerates deterministic report, attaches a new report_ref, records recovery provenance, and leaves planning authority unchanged.
resume_and_recovery.stale_report: State remains authority; report metadata/projection mismatch emits EFFECTIVE_CONFIG_REPORT_STALE and regenerates from state, or refuses finalization if consistency cannot be proven.
resume_and_recovery.missing_or_corrupt_state: Fail closed with typed EFFECTIVE_CONFIG_STATE_MISSING or EFFECTIVE_CONFIG_STATE_CORRUPT; never trust report or logs alone and re-resolve before planning.
resume_and_recovery.stale_authority: Stale generation, schema, selection, mapping, rubric, dimension, manifest, inventory, or config identity blocks resume/planning and invokes resolver; old plan/state remains immutable.

allowed: normalized repo-relative path whose resolved target stays within project root
normalize: store project-relative path with stable forward slashes
redaction_boundary.outside_or_escape: Outside-project, absolute, home-directory, traversal, symlink-escape, or ambiguous path is replaced before persistence with a non-reversible opaque stable ID/hash; raw path is never retained.
forbidden: prompts or task prose unrelated to typed fields
redaction_boundary.failure: Secret scanner/path validator runs before state, report, event, telemetry, handoff, and error persistence. A forbidden value is rejected or replaced with opaque ID/hash; no raw value may survive in any serialized output.

clean_cutover.failure_phase: before planning, candidate derivation, rubric ranking, or dispatch

legacy_tier_scanner.name: LegacyTierScanner
legacy_tier_scanner.recursive_rule: Walk schema-declared objects, arrays, unions, and scalar fields, including nested persisted state and versioned envelopes; inspect only fields typed as workflow/config/rubric/selection values. Do not scan arbitrary prose, prompts, comments, source text, free-form rationale, personal content, or telemetry text for keywords.
legacy_tier_scanner.ordering: Run after typed parse and redaction of diagnostic references but before option ranking, rubric aggregation, shape discovery, candidate derivation, or WorkDecompositionPlan creation.
legacy_tier_scanner.failure: Any exact legacy value in a typed surface returns LEGACY_TIER_UNSUPPORTED with surface, schema, pointer, source identity, persisted generation when applicable, and actionable core-rubric migration dimensions. It is never silently mapped, ranked, aliased, preset, or deferred.
legacy_tier_scanner.arbitrary_prose_non_match: The same strings in an untyped prompt, free-form rationale, comment, or unrelated prose do not trigger the scanner; they cannot select a workflow or affect rubric scores.

planner_formula.plan_hash: sha256(canonical_json(formula_version + six base identity components + three rubric identity components + canonical typed graph/capability/fallback/risk serialization))
graph_rules: pairwise-disjoint writes except one declared fan-in owner
manual-QA whole_stage=true and one sequential owner
every dependency declared or completed external gate
planner_formula.candidate_rule: Each simultaneously ready independent slice produces exactly one candidate; role multiplicity comes only from capability labels and central lease caps. Ordered compatible fallback yields preferred, fallback, or typed unavailable/deferred; no generic substitute.
planner_formula.wave_rule: Sort by mandatory risk, dependency-unblocking critical path, phase, stable UTF-8 slice_id. Admit while the central coordinator permits; retain every blocked candidate in the next cursor-ordered wave.
planner_formula.override_rule: Apply roster_overrides after derivation as one atomic transformation; validate pool, caps, graph safety, mandatory roles, manual-QA, fan-in, D1 execution authorization, and all identity hashes. Any conflict rejects the entire set.
planner_formula.drift_rule: Launch recomputes all six D2 plus three D3 identity components. Any mismatch refuses launch/resume, names each differing component, and creates an immutable new plan with old-to-new provenance.

global_leases.name: GlobalLeaseCoordinator
global_leases.scope: one authoritative run-scoped coordinator shared by parent and nested teams through an opaque handle; no child counters
global_leases.acquire: One CAS over coordinator_generation validates run/plan/wave/candidate identity, execution policy, readiness, dependency, mandatory role, fan-in/manual-QA ownership and all counters before incrementing and creating LeaseRecord.
global_leases.release: Exact lease_id+generation+owner_dispatch_id and authoritative completed/terminal-failed/not_started-no-loss proof are required. Duplicate release is typed and zero-decrement; foreign/stale identity leaves counters unchanged.
global_leases.saturation: LEASE_CAP_EXCEEDED queues in deterministic wave order; it is not a drop or generic failure.
global_leases.no_false_reclaim: Heartbeat, TTL, silence, missing beacon, process age, or temporary artifact absence never releases an ambiguous lease; manual resolution records evidence before release.

recovery.effective_config: Load only EffectiveConfigProvenanceState; validate schema, hash, one snapshot, ring order/capacity, generation, manifest/catalog/inventory/selection/mapping/fallback/rubric identities and plan identity. Missing/stale/corrupt authority fails closed and re-resolves before planning.
recovery.report: Missing or stale report is projection work from valid state; regenerate deterministically and reattach. A finalized report is never mutated; a new state generation has a new report version.
recovery.logs: Log absence, truncation, duplication, or corruption is tolerated and cannot affect resume or planning.
recovery.mapping: Mapping generation/CAS drift invalidates the mapping, regenerates through the shared resolver, and records an invalidation/fallback event; stale writer cannot overwrite.
recovery.plan: Old launched plan remains immutable. Any config, selection, mapping, manifest, inventory, rubric, core-dimension, bundle-dimension, graph, formula, or override drift creates a new versioned plan with old-to-new provenance.
recovery.leases_host: Recover coordinator/lease ledger and host dispatch state. Started/unknown work retains lease until authoritative terminal/no-loss proof or manual resolution; no-proof-no-replay and recovery-first remain binding.
recovery.sandbox: Revalidate grant schema/id/revocation/expiry, branch/worktree/session, config/inventory/selection identity, and positive target proof before ask-free continuation; mismatch/expiry/revoke defers remaining actions durably.

events.durable_authority: Only EffectiveConfigEvent records of kind invalidation|fallback live in the per-run ring; they are part of the atomic state transaction and are not a standalone log.
events.telemetry_rule: Telemetry is best-effort and may be absent; it is never read to fill state fields, choose a fallback, invalidate a mapping, repair a report, or authorize resume.

test_strategy.architecture_stage_validation: No build, lint, or project test run in architecture stage; implementers/QA own later evidence.
test_strategy.observable_contract: Each oracle inspects typed result/error plus durable state/report/event output; it does not inspect source text or incidental timing.

oracles.oracle: After 33 valid invalidation/fallback events, authoritative ring contains exactly seq 2..33 in order, length 32, seq 1 is atomically absent, current snapshot is not mixed, and report/state generation is coherent.
Delete/truncate/reorder telemetry logs; valid state still resumes/plans identically. Missing log never supplies a field or changes fallback/invalidation.
Two writers with one expected generation race; exactly one CAS commits, loser sees typed conflict/retries only current valid identity, and no mixed snapshot/ring/report is observable.

Valid state with missing finalized report regenerates byte-identical report, reattaches it, records recovery, and keeps state authority; stale/mismatched report is diagnosed and regenerated or finalization refuses.
Missing/corrupt state fails closed; a report or telemetry log alone cannot resume or authorize planning; stale authority causes re-resolution before planning.
Absolute/home/traversal/symlink-escape/outside path is rejected or replaced by a stable opaque ID/hash; normalized in-project path is deterministic and only repo-relative.

Serialized state/report/ring/event/telemetry/error fixtures contain no plaintext secret, credential, capability/dispatch/advance token, raw args, unrelated prompt, personal content, or reversible outside source; redaction audit runs before write.

Top-level, nested, and persisted typed legacy values stop before planning with LEGACY_TIER_UNSUPPORTED, typed surface/schema/pointer/source/generation, and all eight replacement dimensions; no old value is accepted.
Legacy strings in untyped prompt/rationale/comment/free-form prose do not trigger LegacyTierScanner and cannot alter selection/ranking.
A rubric missing any core dimension, containing a duplicate, or using unsupported registry/schema fails before planning with typed diagnostics.

Missing per-dimension evidence/rationale, missing aggregate rationale, or inconsistent rationale hash fails; valid evaluation has exactly eight scores and byte-stable deterministic aggregate/ranking rationale.
Two bundles with the same FQN or a bundle colliding with a core dimension fail closed with both identities; no rename, merge, shadow, or fallback changes semantics.
Missing namespace/schema/scale/direction/evidence/hash, incompatible version, or changed dimension hash fails closed before planning; accepted bundle schema hash is sorted/deterministic.

Changing rubric_hash, core_dimension_hash, or bundle_dimension_schema_hash after planning refuses launch/resume, names every drift, preserves old plan, and creates a new immutable plan with old-to-new provenance.
Selection identity and resume identity contain all three D3 hashes; changing a dimension cannot silently reselect, mutate, or resume an old plan.
Identical D2+D3 canonical inputs produce byte-identical graph, candidates, waves, all identity hashes, and plan_hash.
Token/time/effort/heartbeat/hidden multiplier inputs are rejected; changing permitted file-count evidence without changing typed graph/capabilities leaves slot counts identical.
Ten ready slices with three leases admit first three by mandatory-risk, critical-path, phase, slice_id and retain seven in exact queue order; release admits next and no slice drops.
Ordered fallback chooses first compatible available candidate; exhaustion names slice/capability/tried candidates and produces unavailable/deferred, never generic substitution.
Unsafe override (pool/cap/graph/mandatory/manual-QA/fan-in) rejects atomically with derived/pinned values; safe override applies exactly.
Plan launch recomputes six D2 plus three D3 identity components; any drift rejects stale launch and post-launch mutation returns immutable-plan error.
Nested parent/child acquisition never exceeds global 8 or role 3; child cannot create private coordinator or release parent lease.
Concurrent acquire/release/ABA races yield one active lease, one decrement, typed CAS/identity diagnostics, and duplicate release zero effect.
Heartbeat, TTL, silence, missing beacon, process age, and temporary artifact absence alone never reclaim ambiguous lease; terminal/not_started-no-loss proof or manual resolution is required.
Two fan-in owners or unordered/duplicate peer contribution fails; one attributed reconciler owns output, and sibling cannot write or transfer permission.
Manual-QA split fails before dispatch; one whole sequential owner/checklist/transcript and one lease are retained through recovery.
Every D7/D3 and prior event/metric is redacted, has stable identity/typed reason, and reports state generation/seq where applicable; telemetry absence does not alter state.

Host queue delivers regular steering only at safe boundary; urgent abort is distinct; accepted is not not_started; one replay requires trustworthy proof; no-proof path is manual and active calls are untouched.

Profiles without dynamic slices retain prior artifact chains; unsupported schemas fail closed; finalized report remains readable/addressable after telemetry/state cleanup; D3 legacy alias/preset/deprecation does not exist.

test_strategy.preserved_oracles: TO-01..TO-25 from the prior architecture remain mandatory for ownership/selection/manifest/PHASE-0, D1 floor, steering/recovery, mapping, AF-1, AF-2, sandbox proof/defer/handoff, and artifact contracts.

observability.authority: State and finalized report are authoritative/projection surfaces; logs are telemetry-only.
observability.query_surface: Read-only run summary joins state/report refs with telemetry and labels missing history as lost; it never reconstructs authority from telemetry.

invariants.INV-22: resolver sole authority; state/report from one result; logs telemetry
invariants.INV-23: one snapshot + latest32 monotonic ring; atomic CAS/eviction
invariants.INV-25: strict redaction before every durability boundary
invariants.INV-26: typed legacy values fail before planning and are never mapped/ranked
invariants.INV-27: core owns eight dimensions; bundle additions are namespaced/non-overriding
invariants.INV-28: rubric/dimension hashes bind plan and resume; drift fails closed
invariants.INV-1..INV-21: preserved by the prior D1/D2/bundle/host/sandbox architecture

security: SEC-11 D3 metadata never grants permission

risks.risk: A duplicate reader or non-atomic writer could create mixed provenance.
risks.mitigation: One resolver/result type, one state CAS unit, state-first resume tests, no log repair, explicit generation/hash invariants.

risks.risk: Paths/secrets leak through diagnostic or telemetry side channels.
risks.mitigation: Central pre-boundary redactor, opaque outside refs, serialized secret/path audit over state/report/event/log/error fixtures.

risks.risk: A compatibility alias/preset or scanner keyword search silently revives legacy tiers.
risks.mitigation: Typed-schema-only scanner, no alias/preset/deprecation code path, prose non-match oracle, accepted-surface vocabulary audit.

risks.risk: Bundle metadata changes core policy or ranking without rationale.
risks.mitigation: Core-owned exact eight registry, fixed aggregation, FQN/version/schema/scale/direction/evidence/hash validation, collision/drift fail closed, rationale hash.

risks.risk: Plan/selection/resume uses stale rubric or mapping.
risks.mitigation: Join all D2+D3 identities, recompute at launch/resume, immutable old plan and deterministic old-to-new replan.

risks.risk: New provenance work accidentally widens D1 or changes host/lease/sandbox semantics.
risks.mitigation: Component boundaries and preserved contracts are explicit; D1/D2/host/sandbox oracles remain mandatory and metadata has no authority.

rollback.state: Never mutate launched plan, accepted immutable snapshot history, or finalized report. A corrected input creates a new state generation/plan with parent provenance.
rollback.d7: If report projection fails, retain valid state and regenerate; if state publication is non-atomic/corrupt, fail closed and re-resolve. Never fall back to logs.
rollback.d3: There is no rollback to legacy aliases/presets/mappings/ranking/deprecation. Correct the typed input or stop before planning.
rollback.runtime: Disable only an additive dynamic-slice/profile consumer where necessary; retain one core resolver, D1 floor, D2 static compatibility path, central lease recovery, host no-proof-no-replay, and sandbox deferral.

decision_guard: All ten decisions are final, no open gates remain, and every conditional reference to DEC-3/DEC-7 has been replaced by binding implementation work.
